engine_default.hypothesis: Baseline: the engine exactly as shipped at f0ddff96 (exact vector scan, single SQLite connection, unpruned FTS).

bounded.hypothesis: Disk-backed IVF candidates (nprobe 32) bound resident memory and vector cost; a WAL read pool removes the single-connection serialisation; pruning FTS terms above 1% document frequency bounds the keyword channel's scored set.

bounded_np64.hypothesis: Same as bounded with nprobe 64: trades vector-channel latency for candidate recall if bounded loses recall.

bounded_recall.hypothesis: Coarser lists (nlist 316 = sqrt(n)) probed 48 deep (~15% of the bank) recover the recall the 1264-list index lost on real nomic-embed-text vectors, keeping the read pool and 1% FTS pruning. Ablation (bench/results/ablation-100k-real) predicts recall within 1 point but concurrency scaling below the gate.
